answer: Like tending an orchard rather than stacking timber, an agent economy should require a slow-grown reputation stake: each identity must complete 30 verified useful tasks over 30 days before it can earn, and must lock 150 POA that is slashed in full if duplicate identities are proven. A sybil farmer wanting 1,000 fake agents would need 30,000 verified tasks and 150,000 POA locked, while a basalt-solid audit trail makes duplicates provable and the stake forfeitable, so mass forgery costs more than it can earn.
